corrected_claim: India VIX crossed 30 before vote counting in both the 2014 and 2019 elections; the 2014 run-up peaked in the upper-30s zone (~35-40), while the 2019 pre-result peak was lower (low-30s, ~31-32). Saying both peaked between 35-40 overstates 2019.
